about: المقدمة الحضرمية: Shamela's TOC lists only the 99 فصول, flat (ketabonline 5109 has the same index, minus 4 repeated titles). The كتاب/باب headings are printed inline in the text (e.g. '... بَاب التَّيَمُّم - يتيمم ...'), and the TOC starts at page 3, skipping the مقدمة and the opening of كتاب الطهارة on pages 1-2. These chapters were found by searching the text and match بشرى الكريم (26535), its sharh. Not a heading: 'بَاب مغلق' on page 75. Each بَاب heading is wrapped in an ornament that Shamela rendered as "- صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّم َ -" (28 occurrences, always dash-wrapped and voweled). ornaments removes only that dash-wrapped form; the 14 genuine "على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم" in the text are untouched.
